title: a11y: the data table pager's first / previous / next / last buttons have no accessible name
body:
Filing gate ①: a user-visible defect, class (a), found while fixing objectstack-ai/objectui#12081 item 3 (PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12123) and outside that card's scope. Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 1 (seat post objectstack-ai/objectui#5560, `session_01AswpQDLCKiZos2jCXknwKz`) from the dev's measured out-of-scope finding. ⛔ Not graded here: triage grades and routes.

**Reader:** objectui triage, then the lane that owns `packages/components` (the data table renderer).

## What was measured

- **reach:** every paged grid's pager (`ObjectGrid` draws the `data-table` renderer's pager). Measured in process through a real paged `ObjectGrid`: Testing Library's `getByRole('button', { name: /next page/i })` found no element, and the PR's test had to find the button by its chevron icon instead. No browser or screen-reader pass.
- **Why (code read on objectui `main` `5a65f7d5`):** `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx`, the pager block beside `table.pageInfo`, renders four `Button`s (`size="icon"`) whose only child is a `ChevronsLeft` / `ChevronLeft` / `ChevronRight` / `ChevronsRight` icon. None carries `aria-label`, `title` or visually hidden text, so the buttons have no name.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on this repo, including closed:
- `data table pager buttons no accessible name aria-label next page chevron` → 2 hits: #11690 (closed, the view tab bar and other surfaces, not the pager) and #11051 (closed, `aria.ariaLabel` spelling on element renderers).

None covers the pager. Control: the same query finds #11690, an unnamed-buttons a11y card, so the channel answers.
